For a real number $x$, define $K(x) = \int_1^x J(u)/u^2 \, du$, an oriented interval integral (so $K(x) = -\int_x^1 J(u)/u^2 \, du$ when $x < 1$) that is taken to be $0$ when $J(u)/u^2$ is not integrable on the interval between $1$ and $x$.

nodes.summary: Let $q$ be a natural number, write $s_q(n)$ for the sum of the base-$q$ digits of a natural number $n$ (with $s_q(n) = n$ when $q \le 1$), and let $h$ be Delange's series in base $q$. For a real number $x$, let $n_x$ be the floor of $x$ when $x \ge 0$ and $n_x = 0$ when $x < 0$. The remainder of the Trollope–Delange formula is $J(x) = (1 + n_x - x)\, s_q(n_x) - h(x)$.

nodes.title: Periodicity of the Trollope–Delange fluctuation

nodes.summary: Let $q$ be a natural number and let $h$ be Delange's series in base $q$. The Trollope–Delange fluctuation in base $q$ is the function of a real number $x$ given by $F(x) = \frac{q - 1}{2}(1 + \lfloor x \rfloor - x) + q^{1 + \lfloor x \rfloor - x}\, h(q^{x - \lfloor x \rfloor - 1})$, where $\lfloor x \rfloor$ is the floor of $x$.
nodes.title: Trollope–Delange fluctuation

nodes.summary: For every natural number $q \ge 2$, Delange's function $g$ in base $q$ satisfies $g(x) = O(1)$ as $x \to +\infty$.

nodes.title: Delange's function vanishes at zero

nodes.summary: For a natural number $q$, Delange's function in base $q$ is the function of a real number $x$ given by $g(x) = \int_0^x \left(\lfloor q t \rfloor - q \lfloor t \rfloor - \frac{q - 1}{2}\right) dt$, where $\lfloor \cdot \rfloor$ is the floor function.
nodes.title: Delange's function

nodes.summary: For every natural number $q$, Delange's series $h$ in base $q$ satisfies $h(0) = 0$.
nodes.title: Delange's series vanishes at zero

nodes.summary: For a natural number $q$, let $g$ be Delange's function in base $q$. Delange's series in base $q$ is the function of a real number $x$ given by $h(x) = \sum_{r \ge 0} g(q^r x)/q^r$, where the sum is taken to be $0$ when the series is not summable.
nodes.title: Delange's series

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
